design: BOSS: Queen of Shadows, an adult humanoid sorceress with pale slate-blue skin, long sweeping SILVER-WHITE hair, narrow violet eyes and an imperious spiteful expression. A small black thorn crown, modest high-neck midnight-purple/black medieval gown with restrained silver trim, fitted covered sleeves/gloves, dark belt, long ragged purple cape and dark boots. Holds ONE SHORT black/silver crescent scepter beside waist, top no higher than head in idle, retained in every pose; free hand casts. Polished stylized fantasy like player mages, elegant dangerous adversary not cute or sensual. Idle boots fixed and breathing/blink, hurt recoils angrily with scepter, attack winds free hand then thrusts casting palm toward RIGHT, no detached spell, dodge crouches/leans back with cape close and recovers. Preserve blue skin/white hair/crown identity and two arms/two legs throughout. Wide transparent cell margins.
